newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm oil prices were steady in late trading on Friday as the market awaited Malaysian oil imports and market intervention, traders said.
Ready palm olein was trading in a wider range at 1,475-90 rupiah/kg from 1,480-85 earlier. Second-half September delivery was quoted in a similar range after earlier being quoted at 1,470-75 rupiah.
Traders said the government was expected to commence market operations to lower local prices by next week when 11,000 tonnes of olein imported from Malaysia was expected to arrive.
One trader said the government planned to import up to 60,000 tonnes but this could not be confirmed.
No crude palm oil tenders were heard but over-the-counter deals were heard at 60 rupiah/kg, one trader said.
